candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502 across all sampled traces; inventory/reservations succeed, so the failure is bounded to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; the internal cause of the 503 (config, saturation, crash) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent 503 from payment on /v1/authorizations propagating to order 502 and gateway checkout 502, while inventory reservations return 200. Gateway metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. Root cause is bounded to the payment dependency; its internal mechanism remains unproven.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for the 503 window to identify the internal failure mode
Payment service version/deployment facts to rule out bad-configuration
